# PRT031 `invalid-tab`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

Tab characters in Fortran code (reported once per file).

## Why

Tab is not in the Fortran character set. Compilers accept it with a warning (or interpret it
specially in fixed form), and its width differs between editors, which breaks fixed-form column
rules. Use spaces.

## Reported

```fortran
x = 1
```

## Preferred

```fortran
x = 1
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[PRT031] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = PRT031` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `PORT031` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
